text: The meeting the series has been building toward: Carol Jennings and Store Operations watching their inventory move live, after the July 4th weekend that cost roughly $42,000 in stockouts caught two days too late.
Live, on real stores: days of supply and the at-risk flag updating as sales happen, each SKU judged against its own pace, not one number for the whole store.
Then the harder part: naming the week the merge Task sat silently suspended -- what happened, why it was a genuine blind spot, and what's watching for it now.
The honest answer to 'won't this happen again': this exact failure mode is covered now. Not every possible failure -- this one, specifically.
The dashboard is adopted. Next: writing down what this means so it survives without us standing next to it.
